title: Parse customer-entered amounts
issue: Customers paste amounts like `"$1,234.50"` or `" 12 "` into the billing portal. Add `parse_amount(text)` in a new module `ledgerly/parsing.py` that turns such text into an amount: ignore surrounding whitespace, an optional leading `$` and thousands separators. Reject text that is not a valid non-negative amount with at most two decimal places.
